#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <ctime>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353LL;
const int MAXF = 200001;
ll fac[MAXF];
ll power(ll x, ll y, ll m) {
    if (y < 0) return 0;
    ll ans = 1;
    x %= m;
    while (y > 0) {
        if (y & 1) ans = (ans * x) % m;
        y >>= 1;
        x = (x * x) % m;
    }
    return ans;
}
ll choose(int n, int k) {
    ll den = (fac[k] * fac[n-k]) % MOD;
    ll denInv = power(den, MOD-2, MOD);
    return (fac[n] * denInv) % MOD;
}
int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int N;
    ll K;
    cin >> N >> K;
    if (K >= N) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    int C = N - K;
    fac[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 200000; i++) {
        fac[i] = (i * fac[i-1]) % MOD;
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    int sign = 1;
    for (int i = C; i > 0; i--) {
        ll val = (choose(C, i) * power(i, N, MOD)) % MOD;
        ans += sign * val;
        ans = (ans + 2 * MOD) % MOD;
        sign *= -1;
    }
    ll mult = (2 * choose(N, C)) % MOD;
    if (C == N) mult = 1;
    cout << (ans * mult) % MOD << endl;
    return 0;
}
